We deliver within 3.5 km of the restaurant

Delivery covers addresses within 3.5 km of our door in Bolar, Mangaluru — free under 500 m, then ₹25 up to 1 km, ₹40 up to 2 km, ₹55 up to 3 km and ₹70 up to 3.5 km. GST (2.5% CGST + 2.5% SGST) applies to food only, never to the delivery charge. Add your dishes, fill in your details, choose pickup or delivery, and we’ll send the order straight to our WhatsApp. Further out, or collecting in person? Call 070227 71888.
